TreadXLGPS_popup.title: Baja75 Navigation Unit: Pop up
TreadXLGPS_popup.desc: With the unit on the vehicle's screen: opens it big in the middle of the view to edit, and back

TreadXLGPS_record.title: Baja75 Navigation Unit: Start / stop recording
TreadXLGPS_record.desc: Starts recording a new course, or stops and saves the current one

TreadXLGPS_mark.title: Baja75 Navigation Unit: Mark waypoint
TreadXLGPS_mark.desc: Drops a waypoint at your position using the last symbol picked on the GPS

TreadXLGPS_chaseNext.title: Baja75 Navigation Unit: Chase next vehicle
TreadXLGPS_chaseNext.desc: Tracks the next-nearest vehicle in Chase mode (cycles back to off)

TreadXLGPS_orientation.title: Baja75 Navigation Unit: Track up / North up
TreadXLGPS_orientation.desc: Switches the GPS map between track-up and north-up

TreadXLGPS_button1.title: Baja75 Navigation Unit: Button 1 (Mode)
TreadXLGPS_button1.desc: Switches the GPS mode: Chase, Rally, Tuner, Adventure

TreadXLGPS_button2.title: Baja75 Navigation Unit: Button 2 (Display)
TreadXLGPS_button2.desc: Switches what the GPS screen shows: the map, the video player or the music player

TreadXLGPS_button3.title: Baja75 Navigation Unit: Button 3 (Home)
TreadXLGPS_button3.desc: The GPS's button 3 - reserved for a future update

TreadXLGPS_button4.title: Baja75 Navigation Unit: Button 4 (not used yet)
TreadXLGPS_button4.desc: The GPS's button 4 - reserved for a future update

TreadXLGPS_button5.title: Baja75 Navigation Unit: Button 5 (not used yet)
TreadXLGPS_button5.desc: The GPS's button 5 - reserved for a future update

TreadXLGPS_mediaVolUp.title: Baja75 Navigation Unit: Media volume up
TreadXLGPS_mediaVolUp.desc: Raises the GPS video / music volume

TreadXLGPS_mediaVolDown.title: Baja75 Navigation Unit: Media volume down
TreadXLGPS_mediaVolDown.desc: Lowers the GPS video / music volume

TreadXLGPS_mediaMute.title: Baja75 Navigation Unit: Media mute
TreadXLGPS_mediaMute.desc: Mutes or unmutes the GPS video / music

TreadXLGPS_mediaPlayPause.title: Baja75 Navigation Unit: Media play / pause
TreadXLGPS_mediaPlayPause.desc: Plays or pauses the GPS video / music

TreadXLGPS_mediaSplit.title: Baja75 Navigation Unit: Split screen
TreadXLGPS_mediaSplit.desc: Turns the GPS split screen (map + video / music) on or off

TreadXLGPS_mediaFull.title: Baja75 Navigation Unit: Full screen video
TreadXLGPS_mediaFull.desc: Video full screen: the whole GPS screen, or the whole split side when split screen is on

TreadXLGPS_passRequest.onDown: if TreadXLGPS and TreadXLGPS.actionPassRequest then TreadXLGPS.actionPassRequest() end
TreadXLGPS_passRequest.title: Baja75 Navigation Unit: Request a pass
TreadXLGPS_passRequest.desc: During a race: asks every driver within 100 m to let you pass (their unit or Alerts app shows it)

TreadXLGPS_passOk.onDown: if TreadXLGPS and TreadXLGPS.actionPassOk then TreadXLGPS.actionPassOk() end
TreadXLGPS_passOk.title: Baja75 Navigation Unit: OK to pass
TreadXLGPS_passOk.desc: Answers the newest pass request with OK TO PASS
